pair_union_s.def: sum of the 1 ms intervals after the event start in which either leg of the event pair (event leg + its diagonal) has pad contact force <= 0
pair_union_s.window: event start .. run end (12..60 s after the event)

pair_last_touch_s.def: end of the last such union interval, relative to the event start

<leg>_first_s/_sum_s/_last_touch_s/_n/_m.def: per-leg 1 ms lift intervals after the event (first start, total, last end, count, max pad gap)
<leg>_first_s/_sum_s/_last_touch_s/_n/_m.relation: pair_union_s <= sum of the two pair legs' sum_s

reapproach_starts.def: (t - t_ev, leg) of the controller events leg_reapproach_start

offset_s.def: event start = branch time (on the 0.1 s grid) + PRE_S 0.5 s + offset_s
offset_s.relation: phase phi = offset_s mod 0.1 s relative to the controller samples

load_<leg>_kN.def: controller lower load estimate = cylinder_force_lower_N - seal band (C2Controller._load_estimate_N) at the period read
load_<leg>_kN.code: c2.py:5584-5588, logged by u10 patch of _update_lifted_reapproach
load_<leg>_kN.relation: start level = load_fraction_of_F_min x F_min; exit level = F_min + exit_margin_N = 14.415 kN

active.def: active re-approach runs after the period: <leg>:<exit_samples_seen>[:rt = re-trigger]

low_<leg>.relation: reset while another leg is active (single_leg)

t_reload_s.def: first 1 ms time after the event leg's first lift with r67 F column (pad contact - rod weight) >= exit level

t_hold_end_s.def: last 1 ms time before the event leg's second lift with F >= exit level

samples_in_window.def: controller sample times (t - t_ev) inside the loaded window
samples_in_window.relation: 3 samples needed for the event leg exit (exit_samples)

event_leg_exit_s / diag_start_s.def: end of the event leg's run / start of the diagonal leg's run (u11 from the period log)
event_leg_exit_s / diag_start_s.relation: equal in every run (single_leg hand-over on the same period)

diag_first_lift_end_s.def: end of the diagonal leg's first 1 ms lift interval

same_times.relation: discrete_alias = same_times and same event counts and same command_stats

rerun.deterministic: no seeded noise in these settings; VBM lines reproduce the stored commands_sha256
